name: dsh-multimodal-video
description: DeepSeek Harness host plugin: vision (image recognition/OCR/QA) + generate_image (text-to-image and reference-image editing with aspect-ratio matching) + show_image (inline local image display) + analyze_video (temporal video understanding via ffmpeg-extracted contact sheets, difference sheets, motion-guided high-resolution detail frames and scene keyframes), plus text-only-model image-strip adaptation at the llm/stream boundary, plus auto-downscaled previews for images exceeding the harness attachment admission limits.
